links.outcome: Sepsis prediction performance of COMPOSER-LLM versus standalone COMPOSER on same encounters
links.effect: COMPOSER-LLM had sensitivity 72.1%, PPV 52.9%, F-1 61.0%, and 0.0087 false alarms per patient hour, outperforming standalone COMPOSER; prospective validation yielded similar results.
links.quote: Evaluated on 2,500 patient encounters, COMPOSER-LLM achieved a sensitivity of 72.1%, positive predictive value of 52.9%, F-1 score of 61.0%, and 0.0087 false alarms per patient hour, outperforming the standalone COMPOSER model.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to extract context from unstructured clinical notes to refine high-uncertainty predictions from a structured-data predictive model
Manual chart review of false positives to assess clinical utility

screen.reason: The study evaluates the prospective implementation of COMPOSER-LLM, where an LLM is used as an escalation/adjudication safeguard for high-uncertainty predictions from a traditional sepsis risk model.

primary.practice: LLM-based context extraction for high-uncertainty predictions
